description: Introducing the Meguiar's DA Microfiber Correction System 5" Starter Kit, the ultimate solution for eliminating moderate defects without creating swirls. With this selection of top-quality products, anyone can confidently tackle moderate defects and restore your car's finish, all from the comfort of home.
